entities.summary: Edna Arbel is an Israeli lawyer who was a justice on the Supreme Court of Israel from May 2004 to June 2014. She is a native of Jerusalem. Edna Arbel was a legal figures from Jerusalem (b. 1944-06-22, Jerusalem). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
